Name: Sandy Goes to the Beach
Author: violetlizabet
Description:
When using Ginger Island Mainland Adjustments, Sandy can go to the Ginger Island Resort! However, she's stuck in her usual clothing. This mod adds beach clothing for Sandy (she wears a blue swimsuit). 

[size=5][u]How to Use This Mod[/u][/size]
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10004]Ginger Island Mainland Adjustments[/url]﻿, if you haven't already
[*]Download this mod
[*]Unzip
[*]Place in Mods folder
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]
[size=5][u]Compatibility[/u][/size]
This mod is not compatible with any other mod that Loads sprites or a portrait for Sandy while she's at the beach. Other than that, it should be fully compatible. 

Notably, if you have [url=https://diversestardewvalley.weebly.com]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url] installed, it will automatically disable its beach portrait/sprites for Sandy. If you have DSV installed and have modded Sandy, I recommend not installing Sandy Goes to the Beach as it would not match with her background and style of dress. 

This mod includes a portrait in the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url], based on Sandy's portrait by ﻿Poltergeister. Per the permissions section on that mod, the Sandy portrait was created by Poltergeister and is permitted to be used freely as long as credit is given and the mod is not paywalled. Credit goes to Poltergeister for the original Sandy portrait (everything except the bathing suit and hairbow colors). 

[size=5][u]Thanks[/u][/size]
Thanks to atravita for mentioning Sandy needed beach sprites!
Thanks to Magoo for suggesting Seasonal Cute Characters compatibility.
